caption:
STACKS ON STACKS: Ashta pancakes 🥞 

Lots of you suggested @mazarineottawa for the best pancakes so me and @nate.t3 sprinted there to try em 🏃🏿‍♂️ 💨 

Spoiler alert: you guys were onto something 🔥 

I got the Ashta pancakes, and Nate got the tiramisu. Let me start by saying this…..from here on in I want Ashta on EVERYTHING. 

Taste: the pancakes were thick and more of a cake like consistency. THEY ALSO HAD THE SALTY EDGES 😍 which I love! The Ashta and honey were the perfect toppings, it made sure that the pancake wasn’t too dry but also added that subtle sweetness to it all. Tiramisu was good also but could have used a little bit more syrup to balance everything out. 

Price: $17 for two pancakes. IMHO they were pretty filling and so delicious so the price is just.

Overall: 9.5/10 ⭐️
